item.title: Full-Stack Developer (NestJS / Next.js) в Acme iGaming, віддалено
item.description:
Acme iGaming builds real-money casino products for regulated markets. We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer to own features end to end.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with TypeScript
  • NestJS and Node.js on the backend, PostgreSQL, Redis
  • Next.js / React on the frontend
  • Real-time features over WebSocket
  • Experience with AWS

Nice to have: iGaming domain, Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

Fully remote, $3500–4500 per month.
